seoTitle: Pace Calculator - Running Speed & Finish Time
metaDescription: Free online Pace Calculator. Instantly calculate your running pace, speed, and predicted finish times for 5K, 10K, Half Marathon, and Marathon races.
intro: Training for a 5K or a marathon? Our free Pace Calculator helps runners easily figure out how fast they need to run to hit their target finish time.
whatIs: The Pace Calculator is a sports utility that solves the time-distance-speed equation specifically for runners. It converts total running time and distance into a standard 'minutes per mile' or 'minutes per kilometer' pace.
howToUse: To find your pace: Enter the distance you ran and your total time.
To find your time: Enter the distance and your average pace.
To find your distance: Enter your total time and your average pace.
The tool instantly computes the missing variable.
howItWorks: The calculator uses the algebraic formula: Pace = Time / Distance. It handles the complex conversion of time formats (hours, minutes, seconds) into pure decimals for the math, and then formats the answer back into readable MM:SS running terminology.
workedExample: You ran a 5K (3.1 miles) in exactly 25 minutes. 25 minutes / 3.1 miles = 8.06 minutes per mile. The tool converts the decimal (.06) into seconds, outputting an exact pace of 8:04 per mile.
resultInterpretation: Your pace is the exact time it takes you to complete one mile or kilometer. You can program this pace into your GPS watch or treadmill to ensure you hit your race goals.
useCases: Race Strategy: Figuring out the exact pace required to break the 4-hour mark in a full marathon.
Treadmill Translation: Converting a desired 'minutes per mile' pace into 'miles per hour' speed so you know what button to press on the treadmill.
Training Plans: Verifying that your easy runs are actually hitting the specific target pace prescribed by your coach.
tipsAndLimitations: Remember that maintaining a specific pace gets exponentially harder as the distance increases. A 5K pace is not sustainable for a marathon.
The tool allows you to easily switch between metric (km) and imperial (miles) standard race distances.

faq.question: What is the difference between Pace and Speed?
faq.answer: Speed is distance over time (e.g., 6 Miles Per Hour). Pace is time over distance (e.g., 10 Minutes Per Mile). Runners overwhelmingly use Pace to track their efforts.

faq.question: How long is a marathon?
faq.answer: A standard full marathon is exactly 26.2 miles, or 42.195 kilometers. A half marathon is 13.1 miles.

disclaimer: Calculations assume a perfectly flat surface and consistent speed. Real-world race times will vary due to terrain, weather, and fatigue.
